item.title: Making 1000 Wh/kg LiNiO2 Cathode Nearly Strain-Free by Complex-Concentrated Doping
item.description:

ACS Energy Letters | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in using only 5% cobalt-free complex-concentrated doping to stabilize LiNiO2, cutting c-axis strain from 7.4% to 2.1% while retaining 258 mAh/g and 973 Wh/kg. Significance: this near-zero-strain strategy suppresses H2-H3/H4 phase transformations and oxygen loss at the full-Ni limit, enabling 80% capacity retention after 1800 pouch-cell cycles and improved thermal stability without sacrificing energy density.
